sport_summary: Heavy MLB Tuesday slate with 15 games headlining, plus NBA playoffs and NHL Stanley Cup action

picks.reasoning: The consensus edge on Guardians +1.5 at even money is massive at 215 bps — LowVig.ag is a full run-line better than the median of -109. Joey Cantillo gets a tough matchup against Cam Schlittler, but the Yankees' run-line price of -104 at FanDuel confirms the market sees this as a close game. Getting the Guardians to cover 1.5 at even money against the grain of a -215 to -239 ML favorite represents genuine mathematical value.

The Over 8.5 carries a 189 bps edge at LowVig.ag vs. the median of -110, and the Under 8.5 mirror is equally inflated — meaning books are shading heavily toward the Under, implying steam on the Over. Connelly Early is a first-time or marginal starter for Boston while Shane Baz takes the hill for Baltimore, neither inspiring confidence in a low-scoring affair. The 8.5 total is set right at the market consensus line with meaningful price separation available.

BetRivers offers +155 on the Rays -1.5 against a median of +134, a staggering 352 bps of edge — the largest spread edge on the board today. Jack Flaherty takes the mound for Detroit against Steven Matz for Tampa Bay; Matz has been more consistent at home, and the Rays' run-line price at +155 represents outstanding plus-money value on a team favored by -142 to -157 on the moneyline. The implied win probability on the ML combined with this run-line premium is hard to ignore.

BetRivers posts the Phillies -1.5 at +163 against a market median of +154, generating 135 bps of edge. Aaron Nola is a proven front-line starter for Philadelphia, while Randy Vasquez is a back-end arm for San Diego — a meaningful pitching mismatch. Getting a run-line bet on the favored team at plus money with a sharp book posting the best available price is a strong spot.

The Under 7.5 at even money clears 122 bps of edge over the median of -105, and FanDuel is the only book posting it at even money. Kevin Gausman starts for Toronto — a veteran who keeps the ball in the park and limits runs — while Bryce Elder is a ground-ball-heavy arm for Atlanta. Both starters project as quality arms, supporting a low-scoring game under a 7.5 total that is already among the lowest on today's slate.

The Over 5.5 at -112 holds a 109 bps edge vs. the market median of -117, and BetRivers is alone posting this price. The Under 5.5 is being hammered at -102 at multiple books while the Over sits inflated, suggesting sharp action toward more goals. Carolina and Vegas are both high-powered offensive clubs in a playoff setting where 5.5 is a relatively low total.

MyBookie.ag posts the Knicks ML at +169 against a median of +160, generating 129 bps of edge. The Spurs are heavy -185 to -212 favorites, yet the Knicks at plus-money represent genuine value for a road team capable of pulling an upset in a playoff environment. San Antonio is heavily juiced, and the best available underdog price at +169 offers meaningful overlay versus the consensus.
